title: docs(adr): ADR-0147 — membership-scoped RLS lowers to an engine-internal org-member semi-join leaf; the visible set stays exactly what it is (Proposed)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi93GrVeZda4ZCMrastvdgi1C)_

Fixes #29360

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:新增 ADR-0147(Proposed),决定 `id in current_user.org_user_ids` 这类成员范围 RLS 不再每次请求预读整个组织成员列表,而是下推为数据库子查询;另给 ADR-0139 D1/D3 与 ADR-0057 D3 各加一条带日期的指针注记。
- 为什么改:#29281 修完后成员列表已精确,但大组织每个请求都要多读一次成员表,且成员数超过数据库绑定参数上限(SQLite 约 4 万、Postgres 65,535)时 `sys_user` 读取直接 500。
- 风险与回滚:纯文档,不改代码、不改 schema;可见集合由 D-0「同集合不变式」锁死,任何会改变"谁能看到谁"的方案都列为已否决。回滚即撤销本 PR。
- 先看:`docs/adr/0147-…md` 的 D-0(不变式)、D-d(不编译的驱动走精确数组兜底,绝不拒绝)、D-e(读取方清单)。
- 两分钟验证:`node scripts/check-adr-symbol-anchors.mjs && node scripts/check-adr-links.mjs`,预期两行 ✅,ADR-0147 的每个代码锚点都能解析。
- 需要你做的:批准本 PR(Tier H,含对 ADR-0139「只此一个叶子」「无能力位」两条禁令在本叶子上的修订),命名已由席位定为 `OrgMemberIds`(驱动编译声明的名字由 spec 卡定),无需你另行确认。

## What changes

- **New: `docs/adr/0147-membership-scoped-rls-lowers-to-an-engine-internal-org-member-semi-join-leaf.md`, Status `Proposed`.** It decides D-a to D-g as #29360 lists them (the #29281 design, os-dev-report `6577634380`; seat ruling `6577690137` item 4), plus **D-0, the same-set invariant** triage `6580364238` asked for as a decision of its own: the visible set is `S(org, caller) = {caller} ∪ {non-blank sys_member.user_id of the active org}`, `{caller}` with no active org, and every lowering answers exactly S on every driver, posture, polarity and size.
  - **D-a** keeps the spelling. `FIELD in current_user.org_user_ids` lowers to a branded sibling of `ReadableIds` (proposed name `OrgMemberIds`; the S1 spec card names the driver declaration; naming is the lane seat's call), carrying the resolver's own `(organizationId, callerId)` anchor. A context that carries an array still lowers the array.
  - **D-b** fixes the inner read to today's read: active-org equality, system authority, no tenant wall (in group posture the wall would widen S), no validity, status or ban filter (each narrows S), and the blank-id guard (which also keeps `!(… in …)` NULL-safe).
  - **D-c** ORs the anchor's caller in, never the compiling context's `userId` (the delegated explainer carries the principal's list under the delegator's id).
  - **D-a / D-d revisit two ADR-0139 prohibitions for this one leaf**: D1's "No second leaf" (kept in spirit: the second meaning gets its own brand) and D3's "No `DriverCapabilities` bit returns" (a consulted declaration, because a refusal is excluded here).
  - **D-d**: compile, or **the floor**, the exact completion-read array of PR #29356, chosen up front and never a refusal. That covers MongoDB, OData, federated objects, the in-process judges and the analytics native-SQL read-scope compiler (`service-analytics` `compileScopedFilterToSql`). The floor substitution descends into composed `ReadableIds` scopes. The explainer publishes the array as `readFilter`, today's wire shape.
  - **D-e** is the reader census re-measured on `cafe8ee6`, corrected from the card: the current-user endpoint and the annotation pins read nothing; the automation, sharing and transport carriers and the presence probes were missing. It says which sites move to the anchor and which keep the array.
  - **D-f** records `rlsMembership` leaves as out of scope, with the reason.
  - **D-g** is the acceptance: PR #29356's two pins byte-unchanged, plus group-posture, NULL-`user_id` negation, caller-arm, no-active-org, delegation, floor-parity, analytics, nested and explain-`readFilter` pins.
  - **Execution plan**: S1 spec card → V1 lowering and floor → V2 SQL family and memory → V3 request path → V4 MongoDB (optional).
- **`docs/adr/0139-engine-internal-semi-join-leaf-readable-parent-ids.md`**: two dated, append-only pointer notes, under D1's "No second leaf" and under D3's capability-bit bullet. `ReadableIds` keeps both as written, and the Status line is untouched.
- **`docs/adr/0057-erp-authorization-core-business-units-and-scope-depth.md`**: one dated amendment note under D3's "mirroring the `org_user_ids` cap" bullet, and one inline `· **Amended**` entry on its Status line pointing at it (after the ADR-0131 entry; the index still keys on `Accepted`). The cap no longer exists after PR #29356. D3's own bound requirement is unchanged.
- **`docs/adr/README.md`**: regenerated by `node scripts/adr-index.mjs` (one row and the counts).

No code, no schema, no test. `skip-changeset`: `docs/adr/**` publishes nothing.

## Tests

None: an ADR-only diff. No forced test edits.

## Acceptance notes

- **Round 2** answers contract review `6583043471` (FAIL on `f3a117fb`): both must-fixes and should-fixes a, b, c and e land in the records. Round 3 applies the seat's two rulings on round 2: should-fix d (ADR-0057-erp's Status line gains its inline `Amended` entry), and naming is the seat's call, so O1 carries no maintainer gate.

- **ADR number.** 0147 is the next free number. The highest on `main` `cafe8ee6` is 0146, and none of the 43 open PRs adds a `docs/adr/0*.md` (each head fetched, `git diff --name-status origin/main HEAD -- docs/adr`, zero `A` rows). 0136 and 0140 are unused gaps; they are not taken, since numbers are never reassigned.
- **Out of scope, carried:** the `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/admin-set-user-manager.ts` comment quotes ADR-0057 D3's "`org_user_ids` cap". The quotation stays accurate as a quotation, and correcting the comment is a server-lane code edit, so V3 carries it (ADR-0147 O6).
- **New public names**: the leaf is `OrgMemberIds`; S1 names the driver's compile declaration. Naming is the lane seat's call (ADR-0147 O1).
- **Seat's mechanism assumptions, measured:** the spec sites are `rls.zod.ts`'s module header ("Subquery-shaped needs are pre-resolved…"), its "does not lower" paragraph and "Dynamic membership", and `execution-context.zod.ts`'s `org_user_ids` and `rlsMembership` docs. That matches the card; the line numbers have drifted. Generalising `ReadableIds` would make S depend on the caller's grants on `sys_member`, so the sibling leaf is chosen (Alternatives).
